title: Investor guide to Ethereum
summary: Explore Ethereum's value as a cryptocurrency and technological infrastructure. Learn about investment opportunities, use cases, staking benefits, and institutional products with CoinShares.
body_markdown:
### The value of Ether


Ether’s value is not only tied to its use as a cryptocurrency but also to its broader applications in decentralised finance (DeFi) and the digital economy. This makes Ether a unique and valuable asset.


[Discover more](https://coinshares.com/en/d/insights/research-data/the-value-of-ether/)


### A system of Real Utility


Ethereum’s robust ecosystem facilitates various use cases, driving its growing adoption and maintaining its position as a critical infrastructure layer in the blockchain space.


[Read our research](https://coinshares.com/insights/research-data/an-anatomy-of-ethereum-usage/)


### Ethereum Investment Case


Ethereum’s technological infrastructure positions it as a critical component in the future of finance and innovation, beyond just being a cryptocurrency.
